info.name: M3allem API
info.description: Android/backend handoff: all 84 implemented HTTP operations, illustrative response examples, separate customer/worker/admin logins and sessions. Current single Neon branch is production, but the API uses staging/mock settings with OTP 111111. Default phones match the synthetic seed. Run Account setup logins, Catalog, then Workers > Read own live worker profile to capture workerId. The collection creates no seeds or admin grants. Set rootUrl to the API server (never a Neon database/storage URL); baseUrl derives from rootUrl. Use folders selectively, not Run all. Examples are synthetic documentation, never usable tokens or captured live responses. See postman/README.md for Android URLs, types and ordered journeys.
